signals.signal: MARGIN CAPTURE VS REVENUE PASS-THROUGH (opened 2026-07-30, same specification as GEV #4). The three falsifiers above test whether AMKR gets the VOLUME. None tests whether AMKR keeps the RENT, which is the moatCapture question and the one this ticker is most likely to fail - the framework already rates moatCapture 2, the lowest of any funnel-passing name. MEASURE: consolidated gross margin over four consecutive quarters while revenue growth stays above 15% YoY. FIRES IF gross margin remains at or below 20% through FY2027 on >15% revenue growth - advanced-packaging demand is passing through to the customer and the PEG-cheap reading is an artefact of earnings leverage on a near-zero base, not of value capture. BASELINE 2026-07-30: gross margin 14.0% (FY2025) and 15.5% (ttm). FULL-YEAR HISTORY: FY2022 18.8%, FY2023 14.5%, FY2024 14.8%, FY2025 14.0% - the four-year peak is 18.8% and the threshold is set ABOVE it, so this falsifier fires unless margin structurally exceeds anything AMKR has achieved in four years. FIRST CHECK: Q3 2026.
signals.evidence: Current gross margins are 15.511% and revenue growth is 25.6% YoY. While revenue growth exceeds 15%, the gross margin remains below the 20% threshold, indicating early signs of potential margin pass-through rather than capture, consistent with historical trends.

assessment.keyWatchItem: Consolidated gross margin performance in Q3 2026 and subsequent quarters, especially relative to the 20% threshold while revenue growth remains strong.
